name: Pack 8: sounds that move
words: The sound lab's music round 2 sounds, each moving by itself: a pulsing bass, a delayed bass, a slow sweep, sample and hold, the dub bass echoing, a dark arp, muted keys, a throbbing chord, a low drone, a dark dub stab.

sounds.name: Pulsing bass
sounds.words: A saw and a pulse with a sub under them through the ladder, nearly shut; the LFO opens it on every 16th, so a held note pulses by itself. (From the sound lab's music round 2.)

sounds.name: Echo bass
sounds.words: FM round made short, into a dark dotted-8th echo: you play one note, the echo answers it twice. (From the sound lab's music round 2.)

sounds.name: Slow sweep bass
sounds.words: A saw and a sub, the filter swept open and shut by a slow LFO over a bar; notes glide into each other. (From the sound lab's music round 2.)

sounds.name: Sample-and-hold bass
sounds.words: The pulsing bass with its LFO jumping to a new place each 16th: a held note that keeps changing colour, never the same twice. (From the sound lab's music round 2.)

sounds.name: Dub bass, echoing
sounds.words: The round dub bass you rated, its tail sent into a dark dotted echo. (From the sound lab's music round 2.)

sounds.name: Dark arp
sounds.words: A narrow pulse and a detuned saw, plucked shut low down, into a dotted echo: written to be played as an arpeggio in 16ths. (From the sound lab's music round 2.)

sounds.name: Muted keys
sounds.words: A triangle and a sine an octave up, struck and fading, a slow tremolo across the stereo: a muffled electric piano. (From the sound lab's music round 2.)

sounds.name: Throbbing chord
sounds.words: Two saws, dark, the volume throbbing in 8ths on the LFO: a held chord that pulses with the tempo. (From the sound lab's music round 2.)

sounds.name: Low drone
sounds.words: A pulse whose width and cutoff wander on a slow random LFO, fading in and out: a dark bed, never the same. (From the sound lab's music round 2.)

sounds.name: Dub stab, dark
sounds.words: A saw and a pulse plucked shut, into a long dark dotted echo: the dub-techno stab. (From the sound lab's music round 2.)

harmonies.name: F minor add 9
harmonies.words: One chord, low and heavy (you chose it twice).

harmonies.name: A minor 7
harmonies.words: One plain chord: the movement all in the rhythm.

harmonies.name: A pedal, the top moving
harmonies.words: A minor 7, sus4, minor 9 over the same A.

harmonies.name: D minor 7 ↔ 9
harmonies.words: One root, the ninth coming and going.

harmonies.name: A semitone up and back
harmonies.words: E minor 7, then F major 7, 8 bars each.

harmonies.name: Sus2 drift
harmonies.words: C sus2 and D sus2, 4 bars each.
